vulnerability.explanation: xmlOutputBufferClose(out) frees the underlying xmlOutputBufferPtr, but the Python wrapper object is not updated to clear its internal pointer. Subsequent API calls using the same Python object (e.g., xmlOutputBufferFlush) will retrieve and use a freed pointer, leading to a use-after-free.
